mission.title: The End of the Beginning
mission.description: Rescue a pair of Bluepill hostages from Exiles.

phase.briefing:
I'm glad that you have decided to continue to work with us. I hope this is a habit that stays with you for your future and the future of Zion. Now, on to business.
Last week, several groups of Exiles attacked a few of our bases. Because of this the Merovingian has given us free reign to take out this batch of scum at their hideout. Additionally, there are a couple Bluepills being held hostage in the area. We need you to pick them up and take them to a safe location.

enter.say: These Exiles aren't tough but there are a lot of them. Be careful!

objective.text: Lead both hostages out of the area
Do not let either hostage die

phase.briefing: Now get them to Menkar and Alcyone at the nearby Redpill Extraction Point. I'm sending you the address now.

enter.say: This is one of our Redpill Extraction Points. The Bluepills will be safe here.

objective.text: Lead both hostages to Menkar at the REP
Do not let either hostage die
